The '''splinter fern''' was a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that was imported to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. Their leaves were very spiny, and were used in acupuncture. When dried, splinter fern leaves also made an excellent cooking spice.
